origin.description: Evaluate a field on a mesh and draw it with quiver.
origin.usage: vectorfield(fun, xlim, ylim, n=16, scale=0.05, col='green')
origin.details: x + y on a 4 by 4 mesh. R time is that matrix, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Evaluate a field on a mesh and draw it with quiver.
origin.example: { xpts <- linspace(0, 1, 4); ypts <- linspace(0, 1, 4); M <- meshgrid(xpts, ypts); pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); vectorfield(function(x,y) x+y, c(0,1), c(0,1), n=4); dev.off(); as.numeric(M$X + M$Y) }
